description: This Kotlin source file defines a singleton class 'WorkManagerConfig' that configures Android's WorkManager with Hilt dependency injection. It provides a custom Configuration.Provider implementation which supplies a WorkManager Configuration with a specified WorkerFactory.

classes.name: WorkManagerConfig
classes.description: A singleton class that provides the WorkManager configuration using Hilt dependency injection.
